metadata_scope: All original versions and raw publication/identity metadata are preserved, including skipped versions. Page and version-license observations are unknown where absent; later PDF download observations are separate.
preservation: All original data records and shards and every previous ICLR2025/ICLR2026 record, shard and order are unchanged. Shared source memberships do not duplicate a paper or PDF.

raw_population_scope.identity_policy: Only previously confirmed identities are unioned by arXiv ID. Every other source entry remains unresolved.
raw_population_scope.input_scope: Every public source entry in the complete original and additional raw inventories; no selected release is an input.
raw_population_scope.version_policy: All original version numbers through the maximum observed version are retained, including skipped and unknown-date versions.

source_coverage_note: The complete frozen confirmed population for all original ten sources is filtered. ICLR2025 remains its separately pinned snapshot cohort. EMNLP2026 has no verified current public source roster and is not represented by a zero-sized shard.

temporal_rule.selection: Earliest-valid greedy maximum sequence; pair adjacent selected versions.
